# Western Metal Industries (WMIPL) — Aluminium Slugs Manufacturer India

> India's largest aluminium slug manufacturer (~75% domestic market share). ISO 9001:2015 certified. Factory in Hadapsar, Pune (411013), Maharashtra — supplying Pune, Mumbai, pan-India and 50+ export markets since 1978.

## Company

- Name: Western Metal Industries Pvt. Ltd. (WMIPL)
- Website: https://www.westernaluminium.com

- Phone: +91-20-26870164
- Email: western@westernaluminium.com
- Products: Plain, perforated, and domed/taper aluminium slugs for impact extrusion
